name: NUTTERX-MD
description: WhatsApp bot powered by Baileys. Authentication and bot settings are stored in Heroku PostgreSQL.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Bot owner's WhatsApp number with country code (e.g. 2547XXXXXXXX). Separate multiple numbers with commas.

MODE.description: Bot access mode: public or private.

ANTILINK.description: Enable or disable AntiLink: true or false.

ANTIDELETE.description: Enable or disable AntiDelete: true or false.

ANTIEDIT.description: Enable or disable AntiEdit: true or false.

AUTOVIEWSTATUS.description: Enable or disable automatic WhatsApp status viewing: true or false.

AUTOLIKESTATUS.description: Enable or disable automatic WhatsApp status liking: true or false.

AUTOLIKESTATUSEMOJIS.description: Emojis used to like statuses, separated by commas (e.g. ❤️,🔥,😂). One is picked at random per status.

ANTICALL.description: Enable or disable automatic rejection of incoming WhatsApp calls.

AUTOREAD.description: Enable or disable automatic reading of incoming private and group messages: true or false.
